notes:
Office Copilot 0.2.6 (beta)

- fix: detect WinGet Copilot CLI in setup and chat

Package: OneNote / Word / Excel / PowerPoint desktop add-ins for 64-bit or 32-bit Office on 64-bit Windows 10/11 (x64 / ARM64 with x64 Office); the setup registers for the Office bitness it finds. Run OfficeCopilot-Setup-0.2.6.exe (administrator rights are required: the COM classes are registered machine-wide; the wizard asks whether the add-ins are turned on for this user only or for every user of the PC), then restart the Office apps and open the "Copilot" tab.

Includes the read-only OneNote MCP server (C:\Program Files\OfficeCopilot\mcp\OfficeExport.exe, started as "OfficeExport.exe mcp"; built from onenote-export 3dde8ed) for VS Code, the Copilot CLI and the Word / Excel / PowerPoint chat (mcpServers in settings.json). Register it as a stdio MCP server: command = that path, args = ["mcp"].

The Copilot runtime is not bundled. Install the GitHub Copilot CLI (npm install -g @github/copilot, or winget install GitHub.Copilot) and sign in; the setup and the chat pane show these instructions when no CLI is found. Each chat turn uses GitHub Copilot premium requests. Excel / PowerPoint writes cannot be undone with Office's Undo (the pane has its own "undo last insert"). 32-bit Windows and automatic updates are not supported.

Beta validation: automated Core/UI tests, installer CLI discovery fixtures, and real pane display checks in 32-bit and 64-bit processes. Install / load / uninstall in both scopes was checked in earlier releases on Windows 11 ARM64 with x64 Office. This release still needs verification on the affected PC with WinGet Copilot CLI and 32-bit Office. The setup is not code-signed (SmartScreen may warn).
